verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair axis for an incident-management SaaS, but the evidence pack never documents bulk or batch actions across many items, such as bulk-resolving incidents, bulk-editing alerts, or batch API endpoints. The general API, MCP server, runbook automation and PagerDuty/Opsgenie Signals Migrator are building blocks or adjacent features, not a documented bulk-operations capability, so they earn no credit.
